description: Diaochan, graceful chinese court lady in the supplied pixel art style. Black hair in two high buns with gold flower ornaments, a layered pink robe with long flowing sleeves and ribbons, a gold sash. She holds a small round fan in front of her chest
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the two black hair buns with gold ornaments, the pink robe with long ribbons at both sides. What she holds is in front of the body and hidden.
guard_action: the right hand lifts what it holds up beside the right shoulder, the left hand lowers, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Calm ready stance holding the small round fan up, breathing
actions.move: Brisk walk in place with small steps, robe swaying, small round fan held up, seamless loop. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Upward flick. Frames 3-6 the knees bend and the small round fan is lowered in front; frames 7-8 the body straightens up tall and it is flicked from below to high above the head; frames 9-11 hold high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The small round fan stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Open-palm push. The small round fan stays at his right side. Frames 3-6 the empty LEFT hand draws back; frames 7-8 the left shoulder turns forward, body side-on, and the open left palm pushes straight out; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The small round fan stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Downward stroke. Frames 3-6 he stands tall and raises the small round fan above the head; frames 7-8 he drops into a deep knee bend and draws it straight down in front; frames 9-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The small round fan stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s4: Pointing out the target. Frames 3-6 the small round fan is held to the chest; frames 7-8 the body turns side-on, a deep step, and the arm extends fully, pointing it at one spot; frames 9-12 hold; the left hand goes behind the back. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The small round fan stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Wide sweeping release. Frames 3-6 the  is wound to the left chest; frame 7 the left foot steps out; frame 8 it is swept wide to the right; frames 9-11 hold.
actions.b3: Two-handed push. Frames 3-6 both hands gather in front of the chest; frame 7 the left foot steps forward; frame 8 both hands push straight out together; frames 9-11 hold.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a2 → b2, 전법 s4. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
